name: rttx
description: Arrange terminal panes in named workspaces and keep frequently used commands within reach.
instructions: On Debian or Ubuntu, download the amd64 DEB and install it with apt. Fedora COPR and Flatpak instructions are also available.
alt: Named terminal workspaces with three split panes and the Places panel

name: Axiotask
description: Manage Google Tasks offline with quick capture, smart views, search and bulk edits.
instructions: Download the RPM, DEB or Flatpak for Linux. On Android, install the signed APK on a device with Google Play Services and choose Connect.
alt: Axiotask quick capture, smart views and task details on Linux

name: axiomd
description: Read Markdown files in a native GNOME viewer with support for tables, images and GitHub-style formatting.
instructions: Use the Fedora RPM from the release, or build with cargo build --release and run scripts/install.sh --user from the checkout.
alt: Markdown document rendered in the axiomd light reading theme

name: Wayfarer Files
description: A file manager derived from COSMIC Files, focused on everyday usability and reliable file operations.
instructions: Follow the RPM or Pop!_OS DEB packaging guide. Installing Wayfarer replaces the system COSMIC Files package.

name: AI Quota
description: See how close Claude Code and Codex are to their usage limits directly in the panel or dock.
instructions: Install the Fedora 45 x86_64 release RPM with dnf, then add AI Quota to your panel or dock in COSMIC Settings.

name: Pulse
description: Track system resources in the panel, with a meter for each CPU core and detailed readings a click away.
instructions: Download the Fedora 45 x86_64 RPM and SHA256SUMS, verify the checksum, install with dnf and add Pulse to the panel.

name: Claudometer
description: Monitor Claude Code and Codex usage limits from the GNOME top bar.
instructions: Install the release ZIP with gnome-extensions install --force followed by the ZIP filename. Log back in and enable Claudometer.
alt: Claudometer usage display in GNOME Shell

name: Focus Task
description: Keep the current task in the top bar and review time spent on tasks, breaks and interruptions.
instructions: Clone the repository, run npm run install:local, restart GNOME Shell or log back in, then enable the extension.

name: Stock Dock
description: Rotate stock prices in the top bar and receive alerts when a ticker crosses a configured threshold.
instructions: Link the extension into your user extensions directory, compile its schemas, log back in and enable Stock Dock in Extensions.
alt: Stock Dock ticker in the GNOME top panel

name: ktask RS
description: Supervise AI coding tasks from a terminal workspace with review gates and observable success criteria.
instructions: From a checkout, run cargo run --locked -- --demo to explore the interface. Use make install for the ktask command.

name: RetroWork
description: A Rust IDE workbench with a docked source tree, tabbed documents and a reusable plugin platform.
instructions: Clone the repository and run cargo run from its root to start the workbench.

name: avz
description: Render an MP3 as a music-reactive video using shader presets and GPU or software rendering.
instructions: Install FFmpeg, clone the repository and run cargo install --path crates/avz-cli. Check the installation with avz --version.

name: Axiolog
description: A proposed graph-based outliner for daily journaling, search and note discovery.
instructions: The repository currently contains design documents. Read the project vision for the planned workflow.

name: Lambda Action Filter
description: A debugging assignment built around an intentionally broken AWS Lambda that filters lists of actions.
instructions: Set up stable Rust and cargo-lambda, then follow the sample invocations and debugging tasks in the assignment.

name: COSMIC Files fork
description: A fork of the System76 COSMIC file manager. Wayfarer Files is the independently maintained derivative.
instructions: To build this fork, clone IllyaYalovyy/cosmic-files and follow the build steps in its README.
